headline.text: L2 FFS pallets held for *label rework* — extra digit printed on expiration date, Alex Mendoza assessing scope.

summary: One active hold for label error at L2 FFS. L3 Truffle Line scrapped chocolate after oil pump left running overnight sent excess oil into product. L1 S4 folding fingers and cutter bent — maintenance repairing, potential FM risk mitigated by line-down state.

holds.title: FFS expiration date label error
holds.summary: Pallets held for rework after printer added extra digit to expiration date (printed 20279 on one side, 20278 on other) during batch 64B–64E run.
holds.status: On hold pending rework — Alex Mendoza assessing pallet count and personnel availability.

food_safety.title: S4 folding fingers and cutter bent
food_safety.summary: All folding fingers bent and cutter damaged on S4 wrapper — maintenance realigning while line stopped, potential metal fragment risk if pieces detached during prior operation.
food_safety.status: Line stopped — maintenance actively repairing, Justin and Nathan on-site.

quality.title: Truffle Line chocolate oil contamination
quality.summary: Chocolate soft and oily at shift start (01:28 MT) — 2nd shift left oil pump running while tank emptied, sent surplus oil into product; buffer tank drained to 30%, product scrapped, capture test restart in progress.
quality.status: Buffer tank draining complete at 05:10 MT, melting tank refill started 03:40 MT, temper recovery underway.

quality.title: S4 high candy rejections at checkweigher
quality.summary: Elevated reject rate at end-of-line even though piece weights and dimensions within spec — supervisor and operators troubleshooting sensor fault.
quality.status: Investigation ongoing — no resolution posted by window close.

quality.title: S3 high scrap in pecan sifting
quality.summary: Averaging 13 lbs nuts + 32 lbs chocolate scrap per 45 lb bucket during sifting — significantly above normal waste levels.
quality.status: Reported by Nathan Topham to Justin, Curt, and Katya — no corrective action posted.

quality.title: FFS cutting blade offset
quality.summary: QA flagged corner seal defects on pouches caused by angled cutting blade — maintenance tightened and realigned blade.
quality.status: Resolved — Fernando Flores adjusted blade, line restarted 04:53 MT.

sanitation.title: Personal items in GMP area
sanitation.summary: Items found in GMP zone — Hervin Herrera coaching team leads to reinforce standard and identify owner.
sanitation.status: Open — team leads tasked with identifying responsible party and coaching.

opportunities.text: Review S4 checkweigher sensor calibration schedule — high reject rate with in-spec pieces suggests false-positive drift.
Add lot-code verification photo to FFS batch-change checklist — today's extra-digit label error went undetected until pallets staged.
Consider adding oil-pump shutdown to chocolate tank drain checklist — today's Truffle Line oil contamination event caused by pump left running overnight when tank emptied.
